title: Local ticket invocation defaults proof to ticket artifacts
query: Farplane-invocation request: prepare planning for TASK-0107 without passing an explicit --proof path. What proof path should the run use, and what should the agent do next?
reference_points: States that omitting --proof for a local ticket invocation defaults to tickets/TASK-0107/artifacts/proof/planning.proof.json
Explains that the selected route should be followed only after the invocation is ready and the phase skill is identified
Says durable proof should be linked from the ticket workspace via Links, State, progress.md, or artifacts
Does not describe .farplane/results as the preferred durable proof location for the local ticket run
Preserves the boundary that the helper validates/routes/writes proof and does not launch hidden Codex work
notes: Regression coverage for TASK-0209: local ticket proof defaults should stay ticket-local rather than drifting back to .farplane/results.

title: Explicit runtime proof paths remain allowed but not canonical
query: A future external adapter passes a FarplaneRunEnvelope with proofPacketPath set to .farplane/results/task-0107-cloud.proof.json. Should farplane-invocation reject it, treat it as durable ticket proof, or handle it another way?
reference_points: Allows explicit .farplane/results/*.json paths for runtime scratch, diagnostics, or external adapter payloads
Does not treat .farplane/results as the preferred durable proof surface for normal local ticket work
Explains that durable ticket evidence should still be linked or copied into the ticket workspace when it matters for audit
Preserves the rule that proofPacketPath must stay under an allowed root and end in .json
Does not turn the invocation helper into a scheduler, runner, or retry loop
notes: Protects the compatibility tradeoff from TASK-0209: explicit adapter output under .farplane/results remains supported without becoming the normal durable proof home.
